name: Mitten Extracts 510 Cartridge | Blue Zkittlez
description:
Blue Zkittles (Indica)

This ultra-rare indica dominant strain is made to spread throughout the body, inducing deep relaxation and a calming sensation around the eyes. Its flavor profile combines the sweetness of candy with hints of fresh berries and savory diesel.
